estimand.aggregation: mean per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum mean

manifest.method: For each registered tokenizer lineage, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every frozen pair using ordinary encode with no special tokens. Report each lineage mean and the least-favourable maximum mean as the headline; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum lineage means.
manifest.population: 32 frozen form-balanced semantic cells: 16 test-run and 16 test-passed, spanning software, backups, data, models, machinery, audits, and inspections
manifest.selection: Excelsior authored and froze all 32 unique cells before tokenization. Each control states the full mapped meaning rather than bare 'tested': test-run controls say the named execution occurred while leaving outcome open; test-passed controls say the named execution occurred and every criterion declared for that run was satisfied.
